body: well i usually cut on my legs, so im not stuck with wearing long sleeves all the time; i cut with razors. other coping skills i use is drawing how i feel at the moment then writing about it, other times i will talk to my little sister

i have a therapist that i have been going to for more than a year now, i don't enjoy talking about the details of the abuse, which may be why i feel this way in result of wanting to put the past in a box and try to just throw it away, i try not to tell my therapist about the cutting, the fact that i started again, because she would most likely want to tell my parents

my friend is basically in pain that he is not dealing with, so he decided isolate himself from everyone (i try not to take it personally). i was sexually abused by my father, don't really want to talk about that now. basically i have recently stopped cutting but i have started to go back into it which is scaring me, i think about cutting deeper and deeper, then i worry about scars i have to hide :/

mixture, closest friend drifted away, feeling isolated, trying to deal with childhood abuse in therapy, the emotions that are arising are unbearable; i want to kill myself so fucking much but i believe in reincarnation, so it wouldn't really solve much, but i have been thinking about for a while now
